findings.title: Payment operation in router.post callback has no idempotency guard
findings.description: A money-moving call is performed without an idempotency key or a deduplication check visible in the same function.

findings.recommendation: Accept a client-supplied idempotency key, persist it with a unique constraint before calling the provider, and return the stored result for repeats.

findings.title: Unserialised read-modify-write in refund
findings.description: `refund` reads a value, computes a new value in application code and writes it back (lines 82-111). No transaction, row lock, atomic update or version check appears in this function.
findings.whyItMatters: Two concurrent requests can both read the same starting value and both write a result derived from it, so one update is silently lost. The window is the time between the read and the write, which includes every `await`.
consequences: Balances or counters that drift from the ledger
Reconciliation failures that are hard to reproduce
findings.reproduction: Send two requests for the same record concurrently: both read value V, both write V+d, and the result is V+d instead of V+2d.
findings.recommendation: Make the mutation atomic: `UPDATE ... SET balance = balance + $1 ... RETURNING`, a `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` inside a transaction, or an optimistic version column with a retry on conflict.

fixes.label: Option A — Environment variable with startup validation
fixes.description: Read the credential from an environment variable validated in the configuration module, and fail fast when it is missing.
advantages: No secret in source or history
disadvantages: The leaked value must still be rotated manually
testing: Startup fails with a clear error when the variable is absent

fixes.label: Option B — Secret manager reference
fixes.description: Load the credential at runtime from the platform secret store (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, SOPS) with a short-lived lease.
advantages: No long-lived credential in the environment
disadvantages: Adds a runtime dependency and availability requirement
fixes.performance: One extra network call at startup or on cache expiry.
sideEffects: Local development needs a documented fallback
testing: Provider outage produces a clear startup error
fixes.compatibility: Requires infrastructure that the target environment may not have.

fixes.label: Option A — Bound parameters
fixes.description: Use bound parameters (`$1`, `?`, named parameters) and pass values separately. Never build query text from request data.
advantages: Enables statement caching by the driver
disadvantages: Query shape must be static; dynamic filters need composition
fixes.performance: Same or better: the driver can reuse the prepared plan.
sideEffects: Parameter types must be explicit for some drivers
testing: Payload such as `' OR 1=1 --` is stored/compared as data
fixes.compatibility: Portable across drivers; only placeholder syntax differs.
